title: Are generative AI text annotations systematically biased?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the prevalence and correlations of concepts (rationality, incivility, interactivity, political ideology) in YouTube comments as annotated by various Large Language Models (LLMs) against a manual human baseline to distinguish between random noise and systematic error.
Evaluating the systematic deviation of LLM annotations from human codes specifically for political ideology categories (Conservative, Liberal) and political content in social media comments.
